problem:
$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=-x(t)+y(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=x(t)-y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above. The eigenvalues of the system's matrix are ${\lambda }_{1}=0$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=-2,$ for which the corresponding eigenvectors are ${v}_{1}=[1,\text{ }1]^{T}$ and ${v}_{2}=[-1,\text{ }1]^{T},$ respectively. Which of the following could represent the phase portrait of the system?

*Hint: Here, the dotted line represents the equilibrium solutions.*
worked_solution:
The general solution of the system is

$$
x(t)=[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}]={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}{e}^{-2t}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

Let's now sketch the phase portrait.

- First, notice that ${x}_{E}(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ are the equilibrium solutions of the system since ${x}_{E}^{′}(t)=0.$ These solutions form the line with the equation $y=x$ in the phase space, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/18fad31b9f69e55d9f4bc414d3e1b732eaee7685bf36a183033fc302e911eb82.png)

- Now, the line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ has the equation 
$y=-x$
and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{2}{e}^{-2t}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. Since ${e}^{-2t}\to 0$ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach the origin as $t\to \infty .$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/40b02cfc27ab7bc7bcc4a76523e106066b6ed6f56c184c7bd1f59a0cd1dcfc27.png)

All other non-equilibrium solutions are parallel to the vector ${v}_{2}.$ So, the phase portrait of our system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/5c35d385e4ce7496a5fbbcbd344ce04583f7eaf8356e1a76a15625b77df75121.png)
